text.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ أَرَءَيْتَ إِذْ أَوَيْنَآ إِلَى ٱلصَّخْرَةِ فَإِنِّى نَسِيتُ ٱلْحُوتَ وَمَآ أَنسَىٰنِيهُ إِلَّا ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَنْ أَذْكُرَهُۥ ۚ وَٱتَّخَذَ سَبِيلَهُۥ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ عَجَبًۭا

baseline.text: Yardımcısı, Kayaya sığındığımız zamanı hatırlıyor musun? Balığı orada unuttum. Onu anmayı bana ancak şeytan unutturdu. Balık şaşılacak biçimde denizde yolunu tuttu, dedi.

findings.text: Özel bellekte kalan balık olayı ancak dile getirilince iki yolcu için geri bulunabilir bir rotaya dönüşür; hatırlama paylaşılan sözle etkili olur.
Sert kaya, akışkan denizdeki olağanüstü olayı konumlandıran sabit bir işaret noktası olur.

activation_trace.role: Producing speech by articulation supplies the public act that restores the absent event.
The alerting and inform-me use frames what follows as a disclosure demanding attention.
Loss of a remembered item supplies the lapse that the utterance reverses.
The rebellious agent supplies the text's named blocker rather than leaving the lapse causally blank.
Bringing something back after forgetting supplies the repaired endpoint of the memory sequence.

changed_reading.after: The utterance is recovered testimony: it identifies an obstructed memory channel and repairs it by voicing the event.
changed_reading.before: The speaker merely reports an ordinary lapse concerning the fish.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The alerting أَرَءَيْتَ opens a report whose doubled ن س ي is opposed by أَنْ أَذْكُرَهُ.
baseline_models.mechanism: A spoken disclosure brings an absent event back into shared attention. The explicit agent in the exceptive clause makes the lapse an interruption of recall, while ذ ك ر marks the recovery that the report now performs.

activation_trace.role: Joining a gathering and sheltering direction supplies the stationary human pole of the event.
The great hard rock gives the refuge material solidity and fixes the threshold.
The fish branch fixes the moving subject as an aquatic creature crossing away from the refuge.
Making or acquiring something for oneself supplies the fish's active formation of its route.
An extended way that can be traveled turns disappearance into legible movement.
Abundant open water supplies the mobile expanse opposed to the rock's solidity.

changed_reading.after: The rock is a hinge where sheltered solidity opens into a self-made route through mobile water.
changed_reading.before: The rock and sea are successive geographical details in a recollection.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَوَيْنَا إِلَى ٱلصَّخْرَةِ is answered by the fish's وَٱتَّخَذَ سَبِيلَهُ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The humans gather at a hard, stable refuge, while the aquatic creature actively makes a traversable way into wide water. The same point is therefore both a place of shelter and an exit threshold.

activation_trace.role: Seeing by eye or insight supplies the demand to attend to the event.
A traversable extended path gives the strange event a coherent object rather than diffuse amazement.
Wonder at an unfamiliar or unexplained event marks the route as interpretively unfinished.

changed_reading.after: Wonder flags the route as an anomaly whose cause and significance remain open for further reading.
changed_reading.before: عَجَبًا is an affective flourish attached to an unusual disappearance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَرَءَيْتَ and عَجَبًا bracket the account of the fish's path.
baseline_models.mechanism: Directed attention precedes a route whose unfamiliarity and unknown cause produce wonder. The affect is therefore also an epistemic marker: this movement is not yet assimilated to ordinary explanation.

activation_trace.role: Reaching a limit or goal establishes the journey's intended arrival condition.
Gathering separated things into one supplies the confluence at which the sign occurs.
A descending passage or burrow gives the fish-route the shape of an entrance left at the junction.
Crossing and passing through a place supplies the overshoot that makes recall consequential.
Seeking a thing turns the recalled anomaly into the criterion that identifies the goal.
Returning something to its prior place supplies the travel reversal caused by recognition.
Following after a predecessor supplies the retraceable line back toward the missed point.
Tracking an أثر step by step turns the prior journey into navigable evidence.

changed_reading.after: The remembered path is operational evidence: it identifies the missed destination and reverses an overshot journey.
changed_reading.before: The fish's path is a marvelous incident remembered after a rest.

context_deltas.mechanism: The travelers intend to reach a joining point, arrive without recognizing it, pass beyond it, and then treat the recalled fish-event as exactly what they sought. Return and stepwise trace-following convert the fish's strange route from spectacle into waypoint evidence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies destination, arrival, overshoot, recollection, seeking, return, and trace-following; I infer the arrow recalled anomaly -> waypoint recognition. A live alternative is that the fish-event merely coincides with the waypoint rather than functioning as an intentional sign.
structural_cues: 18:60 sets the destination, 18:61 records unrecognized arrival, 18:62 marks overshoot, 18:63 supplies recalled testimony, and 18:64 reverses travel.
18:61 first narrates the fish, path, and sea externally; 18:63 reconstructs the same event as belated speech.

activation_trace.role: Finding and encountering supplies the immediate result of returning along the route.
Disclosure of a thing to a knower supplies the epistemic destination beyond the geographical one.
Following أثر after أثر converts route recovery into a requested mode of learning.
Straightness of path and guidance makes the desired knowledge explicitly directional.
Complete encompassing in knowledge supplies the missing capacity that makes appearances hard to bear.
Knowledge of the inner aspect of a matter supplies what the learner does not yet possess.
A reminder that makes something present supplies the guide-controlled moment of later disclosure.

changed_reading.after: The route opens a guided knowledge process in which one must follow before causes are disclosed.
changed_reading.before: The fish route solves a problem of physical location.

context_deltas.mechanism: Retracing the route leads immediately to finding a bearer of disclosed knowledge; following him is requested for right guidance. Patience is then tied to incomplete encompassing knowledge, and mention is deferred until the guide initiates it. The focus route thus becomes entry into a discipline of following and delayed disclosure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the sequence route -> finding -> following -> guidance and the rule of deferred mention; I infer that the fish-sign initiates an epistemic apprenticeship, not just a relocation. The live alternative is the narrower reading that it only locates the encounter.
structural_cues: The retracing of 18:64 is immediately followed by finding in 18:65 and a request to follow in 18:66.
18:68 contrasts patience with incomplete encompassing knowledge, while 18:70 postpones mention until the guide initiates it.

activation_trace.role: Holding someone accountable for a fault supplies the interpersonal consequence attached to forgetting.
Loss of remembrance repeats the focus lapse inside an explicit plea about blame.
Imposing what weighs heavily supplies the feared effect of punitive treatment.
Difficulty and severity supply the journey-level cost of turning lapse into burden.

changed_reading.after: The lapse also anticipates a question of forbearance: whether forgetting will be converted into blame that burdens companionship.
changed_reading.before: The focus lapse explains why information arrived late.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus combines forgetting with the fish taking a path; 18:73 recombines the same roots as taking a person to account for what he forgot. Added burden and difficulty make cognitive lapse an ethical relation between companions, not only a private failure of memory.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a later grammatical recombination of the same roots with burden and difficulty; I infer an accountability lens on the earlier confession. This does not make the speakers identical or prove equal culpability.
structural_cues: 18:63 places ن س ي and ء خ ذ in the fish report; 18:73 places them together again in تُؤَاخِذْنِى بِمَا نَسِيتُ.

activation_trace.role: Complete epistemic enclosure names the missing frame needed to judge an anomalous appearance.
Knowledge of a matter's interior supplies the hidden side withheld from immediate perception.
A report that comes and is conveyed supplies the promised explanatory disclosure.
Returning a thing to its outcome supplies the endpoint from which the strange acts become readable.
Holding oneself from agitation supplies the temporal capacity required before explanation.
The repeated return to outcome closes the delayed-explanation structure announced at separation.

changed_reading.after: Wonder marks an appearance that should be carried without premature closure until its knowledge and outcome become available.
changed_reading.before: Wonder registers a marvelous event whose oddity is complete in itself.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later lesson separates visible action from inner knowledge and from the outcome to which an action returns. Announcement of that outcome is delayed until after patience fails. The focus wonder becomes the first compact instance of a narrative rule: anomalous appearance should remain open pending disclosure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unknown inner knowledge, delayed report, patience, and repeated outcome-language; I infer that focus wonder prefigures this pedagogy of suspended judgment. A live alternative is that the fish marvel only marks the meeting place and does not model the later acts.
structural_cues: The outwardly objectionable acts in 18:71, 18:74, and 18:77 precede their explanations in 18:79-82.
The focus labels its anomalous movement عَجَبًا before the later discourse explicitly distinguishes appearance, inner knowledge, patience, and outcome.

activation_trace.role: Making or acquiring something for oneself supplies the fish's self-directed taking of a route.
The ship that cleaves the water supplies the vulnerable maritime traveler in the later scene.
The same abundant water-space holds both free route-making and threatened seizure.
Royal sovereignty supplies the organized power behind the contrary mode of taking.
Seizing and capture supply the king's coercive taking of vessels.
Taking property unjustly by force fixes the later action as domination rather than route-making.

changed_reading.after: Within the later maritime echo, it becomes an exploratory counterimage of movement that makes its own way rather than being forcibly taken.
changed_reading.before: The fish's taking a path is only a description of locomotion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus fish makes a way for itself in the sea, whereas the later king takes every ship in the sea by force. Repetition of ء خ ذ inside one maritime frame sets self-directed routing against coercive capture.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated root, sea setting, self-acquired route, royal seizure, and force; I infer a formal contrast between mobile freedom and appropriation. This need not mean that the fish escapes the king or shares the ship episode's plot.
structural_cues: 18:63 and 18:79 repeat ء خ ذ and ب ح ر around an aquatic mover, but assign the taking to opposite agencies and objects.

remaining_uncertainties: The text does not state that the fish intended to signal the destination; that causal arrow remains reader-supplied.
The maritime contrast between a self-routing fish and forcibly taken ships is a formal echo, not a claim of shared plot agency.
The split-root and rock-wall readings should remain qualified resonances.
strongest_changes: The fish's marvelous route becomes the missed waypoint that reverses an overshot journey and leads into guided knowledge.
Forgetting shifts from a private lapse to recovered testimony, then to an accountability problem when ء خ ذ and ن س ي recur in 18:73.
Wonder becomes a marker for appearances whose inner knowledge and outcome are deferred.
summary.what_was_special: The tightest activation was mechanical rather than merely thematic: arrival, forgetting, overshoot, recollection, reversal, tracking, finding, following, and delayed explanation form one route-and-knowledge chain around 18:63.

activation_trace.role: Transmission of report or verse supplies a relay image in which the water-event is carried into narration.

changed_reading.after: As a qualified split-root echo, it also makes the utterance a relay that carries the recovered event onward as report.
changed_reading.before: أَرَءَيْتَ functions only as an attention-directing formula.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's non-dominant ر و ي mapping beneath QAC ر ء ي. It remains anchored at focus word 2 and in the act of reporting the water-event; render it only as a form-distant resonance, never as a replacement for the ordinary force of أَرَءَيْتَ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أَرَءَيْتَ initiates the transfer of the remembered event from one speaker to another.

activation_trace.role: The sea-root's bewilderment branch overlays the literal water with the observer's disorientation.
Wonder at an unfamiliar or unexplained event makes that affective overlay explicit.

changed_reading.after: The route traverses both water and bewilderment, making the sea a qualified spatial-affective medium.
changed_reading.before: The sea is only the physical medium, and wonder comments externally on the route.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The move is surprising because it activates an affective branch of ب ح ر inside a plainly literal sea. It remains anchored by the adjacency of ٱلْبَحْرِ and عَجَبًا; render it as a spatial-affective overlay, not as a claim that sea lexically means wonder here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ عَجَبًا places the sea root immediately beside explicit wonder.

activation_trace.role: The great hard rock supplies the first solid threshold associated with delayed recognition.
The raised wall supplies a later solid structure whose visible condition conceals its preservative function.
Stored and protected wealth supplies what the later solid threshold preserves through delay.
Reaching the appointed limit supplies the maturity condition that ends the delay.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the eventual disclosure side of the analogy.

changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, the rock is the first solid threshold at which a sign is held through delay before it can direct action.
changed_reading.before: The rock is an incidental landmark at which the fish-event happened.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This material analogy is surprising because it links the focus rock to the later wall without a shared root. It remains anchored in the named solid landmark, delayed recollection, and the packet's wall-treasure-emergence sequence; render it as a structural analogy, not as a claim that the rock contains treasure.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: إِذْ أَوَيْنَا إِلَى ٱلصَّخْرَةِ names a solid landmark where the sign is present but its significance is delayed.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Mention converts private memory into recoverable route.** `ذ ك ر` B004 (“mention on the tongue”) appears as the omitted act after forgetting; once spoken, the wondrous fish-path can guide both travelers back. This realizes 18:24’s instruction to remember after forgetting. I infer that recollection becomes causally effective only when externalized into shared speech. The servant’s delayed report repairs the journey’s social knowledge.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:70 and 18:78 showed controlled mention becoming the teacher’s explicit method of retrospective guidance.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **The hard point indexes an otherwise fluid event.** `ص خ ر/B001` is hard massive rock. The fixed recollection binds shelter, forgetting, fish, and wondrous sea-route to that one stable object; 18:64 then uses the report to reverse direction, and 18:65 locates the sought servant after the retracing. I infer that the rock functions as an external memory address: it does not cause the sign but fixes where it can be recovered. `ٱلصَّخْرَة` reads as a navigational index within a moving water-world.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:64 converted the rock-index into reverse movement, and 18:65 confirmed its accuracy by the sought encounter.

words.gloss_range: completed speech verb introducing the companion's reported confession
words.prose: {{ar:قَالَ}} ({{tr:qāla}}) opens a fresh quoted-speech frame: the companion takes the narrative voice and answers Mūsā's prior food request (18:62) with a first-person explanation. The completed speech verb makes the rest of the ayah speech-bound, so forgetting, Satanic causation, and the fish's route are heard as the companion's confession rather than detached narration.
words.root_gloss_range: saying, reporting, and speech-framing; locally a completed quoted-speech launch

topics.headline: confessional speech frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah shifts from travel narration into the companion's direct confession, answering the prior request (18:62).
topics.reason: The perfect speech verb introduces the full quoted utterance, and boundary evidence links this reply to the speech opening in 18:62.

words.gloss_range: interrogative perception verb functioning as a retrospective recall prompt
words.prose: {{ar:أَرَأَيْتَ}} ({{tr:ara'ayta}}) is addressed directly to Mūsā and works less like a request for eyesight than a prompt to reconsider a missed event. Its seeing-root still matters because the fish-sign had been visible, but the following time clause supplies the object: consider what happened when they stopped at the rock. Variant hamza treatments and wider formula evidence show pressure around the address form, while the local force remains a confession-driven recall prompt.
words.root_gloss_range: seeing, perceiving, and considering; locally both missed sight and retrospective understanding matter

topics.headline: retrospective recall prompt
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the question turns Mūsā back toward an already-missed sign rather than asking about ordinary visual seeing.
topics.reason: The second-person perfect with interrogative hamza is followed by the time-location clause, making the question a guided recollection.

topics.headline: address formula and hamza pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the question belongs to a recognizable attention-demand formula, while local grammar keeps it inside the companion's confession.
topics.reason: The broader formula and qiraat pressure are real, but they do not turn the local scene into the adversarial settings named in other occurrences.

words.gloss_range: past-time particle anchoring the confession to the rock episode
words.prose: {{ar:إِذْ}} ({{tr:idh}}) fixes the recall to a definite past moment: when the two sheltered at the rock. The particle reverses the movement of the story from present fatigue and request back to the earlier stopping point where the sign began.

topics.headline: past rock-time frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the confession is anchored to one precise earlier scene, not to a vague lapse of memory.
topics.reason: The temporal particle introduces the sheltering clause and supplies the event considered by the preceding question.

words.gloss_range: completed shared sheltering or retreat toward the rock
words.prose: {{ar:أَوَيْنَا}} ({{tr:awaynā}}) reports a completed shared stop: both travelers took shelter, yet only the companion will confess the forgetting. The sheltering root gives the rock more than itinerary value; it is a refuge or gathering point where a concealed sign is missed. The echo with the cave youths' sheltering (18:10) makes shelter in this surah a setting for hidden divine signs, while the local Form I keeps agency with the travelers moving toward refuge.
words.root_gloss_range: sheltering, taking refuge, gathering, and retreat; locally the pair's completed stop at a landmark

topics.headline: shared sheltering at the landmark
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the irony that the missed sign happened at a completed shared refuge-stop, not during aimless motion.
topics.reason: The perfect first-person plural and following directional phrase identify a completed shared movement toward shelter.

topics.headline: shelter echo with the cave scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that sheltering at the rock belongs to the surah's pattern of retreat scenes where hidden signs unfold (18:10).
topics.reason: The supplied same-surah evidence directly connects the sheltering root in 18:10 and 18:63.

words.gloss_range: directional preposition marking the rock as the goal of sheltering
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَى}} ({{tr:ilā}}) makes the sheltering directional: the pair moved toward the rock as a goal. That matters because the rock becomes a memory anchor and destination point, not an inhabited space or a vague backdrop.

topics.headline: directional goal to the rock
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the grammar points toward a fixed landmark, preparing the rock to carry the memory burden of the scene.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the genitive rock and completes the sheltering verb as motion toward a goal.

words.gloss_range: the definite genitive rock as a known fixed landmark
words.prose: {{ar:الصَّخْرَةِ}} ({{tr:aṣ-ṣakhrati}}) is a definite singular landmark governed by {{ar:إِلَى}} ({{tr:ilā}}). Its hard-stone semantics press against the unstable human memory around it: the fixed thing in the scene is where attention failed and the fish's fluid route began. Sparse rock-occurrence evidence, including hidden-small imagery at 31:16, narrows this from ordinary scenery into a marked place where a concealed sign is implicated.
words.root_gloss_range: hard stone, solidity, fixity, and rare rock-scenes; locally the specific landmark where the sign was missed

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: directional preposition governing the rock as the goal of sheltering

topics.headline: definite fixed landmark
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the rock is a known, singular, solid landmark, making the missed sign spatially exact.
topics.reason: Case government, definiteness, singular form, and hard-stone semantics all support a precise landmark reading.

topics.headline: rare rock field with hidden-sign pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the rare rock-word can evoke hidden things in rock settings (31:16), while the local ayah still names this specific journey landmark.
topics.reason: The occurrence evidence is useful for resonance, but local grammar keeps the word as the destination of sheltering rather than an independent hidden-object claim.

words.gloss_range: explanatory connector joining the remembered rock scene to the confession
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) binds the recalled rock scene directly to the confession. It can be heard as explanatory or causal: when we stopped there, well, I forgot. The connector keeps the admission from floating loose and makes the rock episode the reason the failure now matters.

topics.headline: explanatory confession hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the confession is the structural answer to the remembered rock scene, not a detached excuse.
topics.reason: The proclitic connector precedes the emphatic first-person clause and links the temporal frame to the admission.

words.gloss_range: emphatic first-person confession marker
words.prose: {{ar:إِنِّي}} ({{tr:innī}}) compresses emphasis and first-person self-reference. After the shared {{ar:أَوَيْنَا}} ({{tr:awaynā}}), this word splits the scene into singular responsibility: the journey was shared, but the confession is personally owned.

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: shared sheltering verb that precedes the singular confession

topics.headline: emphatic singular confession
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shift from shared travel to a singular, emphatic admission of lapse.
topics.reason: The inna construction governs the following forgetting assertion, and the first-person suffix identifies the companion as the confessional subject.

words.gloss_range: completed first-person forgetting of the fish, with leave-behind pressure but no proof of intent
words.prose: {{ar:نَسِيتُ}} ({{tr:nasītu}}) first states a completed personal lapse with {{ar:الْحُوتَ}} ({{tr:al-ḥūta}}) as its direct object. The root range lets forgetting feel like practical leaving-behind as well as mental failure, but the local confession does not prove deliberate abandonment. Its force deepens because the same root will return in causative Form IV, and supplied parallels with Satan-caused forgetting of remembrance (12:42) make this memory failure the obstruction of timely mention, not merely absent-mindedness.
words.root_gloss_range: forgetting, neglecting, and leaving behind; locally a personal lapse later reframed through external causation

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the direct object forgotten by the companion

topics.headline: personal transitive lapse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the companion first owns the lapse before any external cause is named.
topics.reason: The perfect first-person Form I verb takes the fish as direct object and precedes the causative explanation.

topics.headline: forgetting with leave-behind pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the fish becomes an embodied lost-memory object, with leave-behind pressure, while intent remains unproven.
topics.reason: The root range includes forgetting, neglecting, and leaving behind, but local syntax and the later Satan clause do not license deliberate abandonment as the selected sense.

topics.headline: memory root escalation and intertext
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a layered memory mechanism: personal forgetting, caused forgetting, and obstructed mention, with a supplied structural parallel at 12:42.
topics.reason: The input links the Form I verb to the later Form IV verb, the remembrance clause, same-surah memory scenes, and the 12:42 Satan-forgetting pattern.

words.gloss_range: the definite fish as forgotten object and sign-bearing creature
words.prose: {{ar:الْحُوتَ}} ({{tr:al-ḥūta}}) is definite and accusative as the thing forgotten, but the following clause will make that same fish the route-making actor. The word therefore holds two roles at once: known provision-sign and sea-creature. Its link with path, sea, and taking makes the fish the nexus between memory failure and route discovery, and the Yūnus contrast at 37:142 sharpens the inversion between a prophet contained by a fish and this fish escaping from Mūsā's companion.
words.root_gloss_range: fish or large sea-creature; locally the known provision-sign whose escape marks the route

topics.headline: forgotten known fish-sign
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the forgotten object is the known provision-sign from the prior scene, not a generic fish.
topics.reason: The noun is definite, accusative as object of forgetting, and repeated from the fish-path scene.

topics.headline: route field and containment inversion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the fish links forgetting, path, sea, and taking, while the Yūnus fish scene (37:142) reverses containment into escape.
topics.reason: The supplied co-occurrence and occurrence rows tie the fish to the route field and to the 37:142 contrast.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction linking confession and causal explanation
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) joins the self-blame to the exculpating explanation. The construction does not erase the confession; it places 'I forgot' and 'nothing made me forget it except...' side by side as two agency frames.

topics.headline: coordinated agency frames
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that personal confession and external causation are coordinated rather than made to cancel each other.

words.gloss_range: negative particle beginning the restricted-cause construction
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) begins the restriction: it negates every cause of {{ar:أَنْسَانِيهُ}} ({{tr:ansānīhu}}) before {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) names the single exception. The result is not vague blame-shifting but a tightly built cause-filter that isolates the adversarial agent.

topics.headline: restricted causation opening

words.gloss_range: Form IV causative forgetting with speaker and fish-sign packed into suffixes
words.prose: {{ar:أَنْسَانِيهُ}} ({{tr:ansānīhu}}) reloads the same forgetting root in Form IV: the companion forgot, and then explains that he was made to forget. Its suffix chain keeps both participants inside one word, the affected speaker and the fish-sign or its mention. The supplied 12:42 parallel, where Satan causes forgetting of remembrance, confirms the pattern without erasing the local double-object grammar; the variant final pronoun vowel only changes recitational shape, not the referent.
words.root_gloss_range: forgetting and causing to forget; locally external causation layered onto the companion's earlier confession

topics.headline: causative double-object forgetting

topics.reason: Form IV causative morphology, two suffixes, and the same-root echo with word 9 support the layered agency reading.

topics.headline: Satan-forgetting parallel

words.gloss_range: exception particle completing the exclusive-cause construction
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) is the pivot that turns negation into attribution. Before it, no cause is allowed; after it, {{ar:الشَّيْطَانُ}} ({{tr:ash-shayṭānu}}) is isolated as the sole causer.

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: excepted agent named after the exception particle

topics.headline: exception pivot to sole agent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the exact hinge where denial of causes becomes assignment of one cause.
topics.reason: The exception particle completes the restriction begun by word 12 and licenses the nominative excepted agent.

words.gloss_range: the definite nominative adversary isolated as the sole causer of forgetting
words.prose: {{ar:الشَّيْطَانُ}} ({{tr:ash-shayṭānu}}) is nominative as the excepted causer, so the clause names an agent rather than a vague influence. The remoteness and adversarial fields make the forgetting a distancing from {{ar:ذِكْر}} ({{tr:dhikr}}), while the alternate burning derivation remains a secondary etymological pressure. Cross-passage rows connect this obstruction of remembrance with 12:42 and the Iblīs disobedience frame (18:50), but here the local task is precise: the adversary alone caused the companion to miss mentioning the fish-sign.
words.root_gloss_range: remoteness, estrangement, adversarial disruption, with an alternate burning derivation noted but not governing the parse

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: remembrance field opposed to Satan-caused forgetting

topics.headline: sole adversarial causer

topics.reason: Nominative case after the exception and the definiteness of the noun support the isolated-agent reading.

topics.headline: remoteness field around blocked remembrance

words.gloss_range: subjunctive complementizer turning the following verb into a mention/remembrance clause
words.prose: {{ar:أَنْ}} ({{tr:an}}) turns {{ar:أَذْكُرَهُ}} ({{tr:adhkurahu}}) into a subordinate mention/remembrance clause. Its payoff is the syntactic openness: Satan may have made him forget the fish, the mentioning of it, or the duty to mention it to Mūsā. The variant with an added addressee pronoun makes that communicative function explicit, but the canonical surface leaves the ambiguity productive inside the restriction structure.

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: subjunctive mention or remembrance verb introduced by the complementizer

topics.headline: subordinate mention clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the forgotten matter is refined into the act of mentioning or remembering the fish-sign, not only possession of the fish.
topics.reason: The complementizer governs the following subjunctive and can be parsed as apposition, purpose, or object specification.

topics.headline: variant communicative pressure

topics.reason: The variant adds communicative clarity, but the canonical clause remains the governing local form.

words.gloss_range: subjunctive first-person remembering or mentioning of the fish-sign
words.prose: {{ar:أَذْكُرَهُ}} ({{tr:adhkurahu}}) is subjunctive after {{ar:أَنْ}} ({{tr:an}}) and governs the fish pronoun directly. The root range makes the failed act both remembering and mentioning, which is why the memory lapse becomes an unreported sign. The wider {{ar:ذ ك ر}} ({{tr:dh-k-r}}) field is narrowed here to the companion's own simple Form I recall or mention, not reminding another person or taking heed, yet it still stands as the answer to the doubled forgetting root in the ayah and the surah's memory-thread.
words.root_gloss_range: remembering, mentioning, reminding, and taking heed; locally simple speaker recall or mention, not Form II admonition

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: complementizer that subordinates the following mention verb

words.gloss_range: connector that can coordinate or resume the fish-action clause
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) before {{ar:اتَّخَذَ}} ({{tr:ittakhadha}}) is a hinge with real ambiguity. It can coordinate the fish's action inside the companion's speech or resume a narrator-like event report, but either way it turns from inner forgetting to outer movement and prevents a hard split between human lapse and the fish's autonomous path.

topics.headline: memory-to-fish-action hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the connector moves the ayah from the companion's inner memory failure to the fish's external action while leaving the voice boundary open.
topics.reason: The conjunction can be read as coordination or resumption, so the positive pivot survives but the exact discourse attachment should not be overfixed.

words.gloss_range: Form VIII path-taking by the fish, locally active and self-involving
words.prose: {{ar:اتَّخَذَ}} ({{tr:ittakhadha}}) makes the forgotten fish a grammatical actor. Form VIII presents the fish as taking or adopting its path for itself, not simply drifting away, and the verb's valency can bind the path and wonder into one action. The exact recurrence of the path-taking formula from 18:61 means the companion's speech confirms the narrator's earlier report, but the second telling moves the same event from tunnel-description to wonder. A masdar reading can nominalize the path-taking and soften agency, yet the canonical finite verb gives the fish active completed movement.
words.root_gloss_range: taking, grasping, adopting, and making for oneself; locally the fish actively takes its path

words.gloss_range: the fish's own accusative path, definite by suffix
words.prose: {{ar:سَبِيلَهُ}} ({{tr:sabīlahu}}) is the fish's own path: the suffix makes it definite and possessed, and the accusative makes it the object of {{ar:اتَّخَذَ}} ({{tr:ittakhadha}}). Its lexical range keeps both route and course in play, so the sea movement is literal while also functioning as the sign's meaningful way. The recurrence from 18:61 is crucial: the same path once described as a tunnel becomes {{ar:عَجَبًا}} ({{tr:ʿajaban}}) here, shifting from physical trace to experienced wonder; the genitive variant under a masdar changes syntax, not the identity of the path.
words.root_gloss_range: road, route, way, course, means, and cause; locally a literal sea-route that also functions as the sign's course

words.gloss_range: preposition making the sea the containing or directional medium of the path
words.prose: {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}) makes {{ar:الْبَحْرِ}} ({{tr:al-baḥri}}) the governed medium of the fish's path. Because it follows a motion event, the phrase can feel both locative and directional, in the sea and into the sea, so containment and movement are compressed into one tight prepositional unit.

words.gloss_range: the definite genitive sea as known medium and vast depth
words.prose: {{ar:الْبَحْرِ}} ({{tr:al-baḥri}}) is genitive under {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}) and definite as the known sea of the journey. Its literal water-space remains necessary, but the breadth-and-depth field makes the fish's route vanish into a medium too vast for ordinary tracking. Same-surah evidence links this sea-word across the meeting point, fish path, ship scene, and the image of inexhaustible divine words at 18:109, so the local sea is both geography and a widening sign-space.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative verbal noun of wonder closing the path-taking clause
words.prose: {{ar:عَجَبًا}} ({{tr:ʿajaban}}) lands as the ayah's final word. Grammatically it can qualify the path-taking as manner, specification, result, or emphatic event-quality, so wonder is tied to the fish's action rather than floating as commentary. Its indefinite masdar form leaves the marvel open-ended, and its recurrence with the cave companions' wonder (18:9) places this fish-path among hidden-sign scenes. At the boundary with the final fatigue term in 18:62, final fatigue turns into final wonder.
